# TransferableNeuromorphicComputing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A paradigm where neuromorphic computing models or frameworks can be applied across different tasks or hardware without significant reconfiguration or loss of performance. This enables reusability and flexibility in neuromorphic systems, reducing development cost and time for diverse in-network applications.
